6: WITH CustomerAnnualConsumption AS ( -- Calculate total consumption for each customer in 2013, paid in CZK SELECT ym.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption FROM bird.yearmonth AS ym JOIN bird.customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE SUBSTRING(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' -- Filter for year 2013 AND c.Currency = 'CZK' -- Filter for CZK currency GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment ), MinConsumptionPerSegment AS ( -- Find the minimum total consumption for each relevant segment (SME, LAM, KAM) SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption FROM CustomerAnnualConsumption WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') -- Only consider these segments GROUP BY Segment ) -- Calculate the differences between the minimum consumptions of the segments SELECT (SELECT MinConsumption FROM MinConsumptionPerSegment WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT MinConsumption FROM MinConsumptionPerSegment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_Difference, (SELECT MinConsumption FROM MinConsumptionPerSegment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT MinConsumption FROM MinConsumptionPerSegment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_Difference, (SELECT MinConsumption FROM MinConsumptionPerSegment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT MinConsumption FROM MinConsumptionPerSegment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_Difference	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing
